```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
```
```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long)x * (long)y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

           - i is always between 0 and m
           - res equals i * n (as a long) before starting the next inner loop
        */

        //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /* Inner loop invariants:
               - j is always between 0 and n
               - res equals i*n + j (as a long) during the inner loop
            */
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long)i * (long)n + (long)j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
```

```
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == Integer.MIN_VALUE;
      @ also
      @   requires a != null && a.length > 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length; a[j] <= \result);
      @   ensures (\exists int idx; 0 <= idx && idx < a.length; a[idx] == \result);
      @
      @   behaviors disjoint;
      @   behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int max(int[] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int res = a[0];

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; a[k] <= res);
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 <= k && k < i; a[k] == res);
        //@ loop_writes i, res;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] > res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
        return res;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
     * - mat.length > 0   : non-empty matrix, require rows non-null and rectangular
     */
    //@  requires mat != null;
    //@  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
    //@  requires mat.length == 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == true;
    //@ also

    //@  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
    //@  requires mat.length > 0;
    //@  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < mat.length;
    //@                              (\forall int j; 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length;
    //@                                   mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]));
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /* Outer loop: i ranges from 1 .. n-1
         * Invariant facts:
         *  - i is at least 1 (it is initialized to 1)
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
```
```
    /*
```
```
     * Specification:
     * - exclude null and malformed matrices (rows null or inconsistent lengths)
     * - for the safe inputs, two disjoint behaviors cover mat.length == 0 and mat.length > 0
     */
    //@  requires mat != null;
    //@  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
    //@  // either empty matrix, or all rows have the same length as mat[0]
    //@  requires mat.length == 0 || (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  // behavior: empty matrix -> true
    //@  also
    //@    requires mat.length == 0;
    //@    ensures \result == true;
    //@  // behavior: non-empty, rectangular matrix -> Toeplitz iff all diagonals equal
    //@  also
    //@    requires mat.length > 0;
    //@    ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < mat.length;
    //@                              (\forall int j; 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length;
    //@                                   mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]));
    //@  behaviors disjoint;
    //@  behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /* Outer loop: check rows 1..n-1 */
        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int a; 1 <= a && a < i; (\forall int b; 1 <= b && b < m; mat[a][b] == mat[a-1][b-1]));
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            /* Inner loop: check columns 1..m-1 for current row i
             * The invariants are written so they hold at loop entry even if m <= 1.
             */

            //@ maintaining (m <= 1) || j <= m;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int b; 1 <= b && b < j; mat[i][b] == mat[i-1][b-1]);

            //@ decreases m - j;

                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
```

```
          @ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; a[r] != null && b[r] != null);
          @ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; a[r].length == m && b[r].length == m);
          @*/

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < i; (\forall int s; 0 <= s < m; c[r][s] == a[r][s] + b[r][s]));
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; c[r] != null && c[r].length == m);
```

Corrected version (only JML changed):

```
public class MatrixSum {
    /*@ 
      @ requires a != null && b != null;
      @ requires a.length > 0;
      @ requires b.length == a.length;
      @ // all rows of a and b exist and have the same number of columns
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && b[i] != null);
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i].length == a[0].length && b[i].length == a[0].length);
      @ 
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ 
      @ ensures \result != null;
      @ ensures \result.length == a.length;
      @ ensures \fresh(\result);
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \fresh(\result[i]));
      @ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length; \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        /*@ 
          @ // Explicit facts that the prover needs
          @ assert c.length == n;
          @ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; c[r] != null && c[r].length == m);
          @ assert a.length == n;
          @ assert a[0].length == m;
          @ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; a[r] != null && b[r] != null);
          @ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; a[r].length == m && b[r].length == m);
          @*/

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < i; (\forall int s; 0 <= s < m; c[r][s] == a[r][s] + b[r][s]));
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; c[r] != null && c[r].length == m);
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            /*@ 
              @ // i is a valid row index inside the inner loop
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < n;
              @ // facts about the current rows of a and b
              @ maintaining a[i] != null && b[i] != null && a[i].length == m && b[i].length == m;
              @ // relate j to the actual row length of c[i]
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= c[i].length;
              @ // the partial sums in row i up to j-1
              @ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; c[i][k] == a[i][k] + b[i][k]);
              @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < n; c[r] != null && c[r].length == m);
              @ decreases c[i].length - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                /*@ 
                  @ // Now the prover can conclude bounds for the accesses:
                  @ assert 0 <= i && i < n;
                  @ assert 0 <= j && j < m;
                  @ assert c[i] != null;
                  @ assert a[i] != null && b[i] != null;
                  @ assert c[i].length == m && a[i].length == m && b[i].length == m;
                  @*/
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

Rationale:
- The crucial addition is "maintaining 0 <= j && j <= c[i].length;" in the inner loop invariants together with the global invariant (\forall r; c[r].length == m). public class RotateMatrix180 {
```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
      @ 
      @ // Behaviors cover all cases and are disjoint
      @ complete behaviors;
      @ disjoint behaviors;
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        /*@ 
          @ // check remaining rows are non-null and of length n
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining m == A.length && n == A[0].length;
          @ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        /*@
          @ // outer loop: rows 0..i-1 of ret have been filled correctly
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
          @                 \forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n;
          @                   ret[p][q] == A[m-1-p][n-1-q]);
          @ loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @ decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // inner loop: columns 0..j-1 of ret[i] have been filled correctly;
              @ // previous rows remain correct
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
              @                 \forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n;
              @                   ret[p][q] == A[m-1-p][n-1-q]);

              @                 ret[i][q] == A[m-1-i][n-1-q]);
              @ loop_writes ret[i][*], j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    /*@ 
      @ // Behavior when A is a well-formed non-empty rectangular matrix:
```
```
      @ normal_behavior
      @   requires A != null && A.length > 0 && A[0] != null && A[0].length > 0
      @            && (\forall int r; 1 <= r && r < A.length; A[r] != null && A[r].length == A[0].length);
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result != null;
      @   ensures \fresh(\result);
      @   ensures \result.length == A.length;
      @   ensures \result[0].length == A[0].length;
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length;
      @              (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
      @                 \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
      @ 
      @ also
```
```
      @ // Behavior when A is null, empty, or not rectangular: returns null
      @ normal_behavior
      @   requires !(A != null && A.length > 0 && A[0] != null && A[0].length > 0
      @              && (\forall int r; 1 <= r && r < A.length; A[r] != null && A[r].length == A[0].length));
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @ 
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        /*@ 
          @ // Loop invariant: for rows checked so far (1..i-1) they are non-null and length n
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 1 <= r && r < i; A[r] != null && A[r].length == n);
          @ decreasing m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        /*@ 
          @ // Outer loop invariant: rows 0..i-1 of ret have been filled correctly
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
          @                     (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n;
          @                        ret[p][q] == A[m-1-p][n-1-q]));
          @ decreasing m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // Inner loop invariant: for current i, columns 0..j-1 of ret[i] have been filled correctly,
```
```
              @ // and i is a valid row index for accesses to A (i < m)
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < m;
              @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
              @                     (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n;
              @                        ret[p][q] == A[m-1-p][n-1-q]));
              @ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < j;
              @                     ret[i][q] == A[m-1-i][n-1-q]);
              @ // ensure the indices used for A are non-negative when j < n and i < m
              @ maintaining (j < n) ==> (n - 1 - j >= 0);
              @ maintaining (i < m) ==> (m - 1 - i >= 0);
              @ decreasing n - j;
              @*/

            }
```

```
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
```
```
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < i; A[r] != null && A[r].length == n);
```

Explanation of the fix:
- The verifier reported an out-of-bounds concern because some invariants (like 0 <= n-1-j) were required to hold even at the loop exit where j == n, making them false. I changed those to conditional invariants (i < m ==> ... and j < n ==> ...) so the bounds assertions are only required when the loop condition guarantees the indices are actually used. This preserves correctness and gives the prover the necessary facts inside the loop body while keeping the invariants valid at loop exit.

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {

            return -1;
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {

                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
```

```
public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1])
    //@     ||
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= (n == 0 ? 0 : n - 1);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j+1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);
        //@ loop_writes inc, dec, i;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];

}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @                   : ( ((long)vec[i] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
      @                        ? \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE
      @                        : \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a)
      @                     )
      @               )
      @           );
      @*/
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        /*@
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i ==>
          @                  ( ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
          @                      ? ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE
          @                      : ( ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
          @                            ? ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE
          @                            : ret[j] == (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a)
          @                        )
          @                  )
          @               );
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @   decreases vec.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
      assigns \nothing;
      // result for each handled operator
      ensures (operator == '+') ==> (\result == (long)num1 + num2);
      ensures (operator == '-') ==> (\result == (long)num1 - num2);
      ensures (operator == '*') ==> (\result == (long)num1 * num2);
      ensures (operator == '/') ==> (\result == (long)num1 / num2);
      ensures (operator == '%') ==> (\result == (long)num1 % num2);
      // result for any other operator
      ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> (\result == -1L);
      // complete specification: for any allowed input one of the above clauses applies
    @*/
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        long output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = (long)num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = (long)num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = (long)num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = (long)num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ ensures \result == (year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0));
    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {
        boolean leap = false;

        if (year % 4 == 0) {
            if (year % 100 == 0) {
                if (year % 400 == 0)
                    leap = true;
                else
                    leap = false;
            } else
                leap = true;
        } else
            leap = false;

        return leap;
    }
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @           && (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length;
```

```
      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ // return true iff the adjacency matrix is symmetric
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    /*@ 
```
```
      @ // Behavior 1: input is null or empty or first row null/empty -> returns null
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires A == null || A.length == 0 || A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @ 
      @ also
      @ 
      @ // Behavior 2: input has at least one row and first row non-empty, but some subsequent row is null or has different length -> returns null
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires A != null && A.length > 0 && A[0] != null && A[0].length > 0
      @            && (\exists int k; 1 <= k && k < A.length; A[k] == null || A[k].length != A[0].length);
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @ 
      @ also
      @ 
      @ // Behavior 3: input is a non-empty, well-formed rectangular matrix -> returns a fresh rotated matrix
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires A != null && A.length > 0 && A[0] != null && A[0].length > 0
      @            && (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length);
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result != null;
      @   ensures \fresh(\result);
      @   ensures \result.length == A.length;
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length; \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == A[0].length);
      @   ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
      @                \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]);
      @ 
      @ // Behaviors cover all cases and are pairwise disjoint
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        /*@ 
          @   // All rows checked so far (indices 1..i-1) are non-null and have length n
          @   maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
          @   maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @   loop_writes i;
          @   decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        /*@
          @   // Outer loop invariant: 0 <= i <= m and rows 0..i-1 of ret have been filled correctly
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
```
```
          @   maintaining ret != null && ret.length == m;
          @   maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < m; ret[ii] != null && ret[ii].length == n);
          @   maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < i;
          @                    (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < n;
          @                        ret[ii][jj] == A[m - 1 - ii][n - 1 - jj]));
          @   loop_writes ret, i;
          @   decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /*@
              @   // Inner loop invariant: 0 <= j <= n and for current row i, columns 0..j-1 filled correctly
              @   maintaining 0 <= i && i < m;
              @   maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @   maintaining ret != null && ret.length == m;
              @   maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < m; ret[ii] != null && ret[ii].length == n);
              @   maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < j;
              @                    ret[i][jj] == A[m - 1 - i][n - 1 - jj]);
              @   loop_writes ret;
              @   decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
Rules (apply all, exactly as written):

- Every method must have at least one postcondition ("ensures" clause). Add more if needed to strengthen the specification.

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    /*@ 
      @ // Case 1: null or empty array -> true
      @ requires digits == null || digits.length == 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == true;
      @ 
      @ also
      @ 
      @ // Case 2: non-null, non-empty array -> result iff all mirrored pairs match
      @ requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (
      @     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length/2;
      @         ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length-1-i] == 0) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length-1-i] == 1) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length-1-i] == 8) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length-1-i] == 9) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length-1-i] == 6))
      @     )
      @     &&
      @     (digits.length % 2 == 0
      @         || (digits[digits.length/2] == 0
      @             || digits[digits.length/2] == 1
      @             || digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
      @ );
      @ 
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining len == digits.length;
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
          @ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
          @     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len-1-j] == 0) ||
          @      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len-1-j] == 1) ||
          @      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len-1-j] == 8) ||
          @      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len-1-j] == 9) ||
          @      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len-1-j] == 6));
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases len/2 - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    /*@ 
      @  // Preconditions: inputs well-formed non-null rectangular matrices of same size
      @  requires a != null;
      @  requires b != null;
      @  requires a.length > 0;
      @  requires a[0] != null;
      @  requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] != null && a[i].length == a[0].length);
      @  requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; b[i] != null && b[i].length == a[0].length);
      @  requires b.length == a.length;
      @ 
      @  // Method does not modify the input arrays; it only allocates and fills the result
      @  assigns \result, \result[*], \result[*][*];
      @ 
      @  // The result is a freshly allocated matrix of same dimensions and contains element-wise sums
      @  ensures \result != null;
      @  ensures \result.length == a.length;
      @  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < \result.length; \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == a[0].length);
      @  ensures \forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < a.length && 0 <= j && j < a[0].length
      @            ==> \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j];
      @  ensures \fresh(\result);
      @  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < \result.length; \fresh(\result[i]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {

        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

            /*@
              @  maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
              @  // rows 0..i-1 of c have been fully set to a+b
              @  maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < i && 0 <= q && q < m

              @  // rows i..n-1 are untouched except default initialization

              @  decreases n - i;
              @*/

                  @  // within row i, columns 0..j-1 have been set
                  @  maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < j ==> c[i][q] == a[i][q] + b[i][q]);
                  @  // other rows preserve their previously established values

                  @  decreases m - j;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    /*@
```
```
      @ // Preconditions: inputs well-formed non-null rectangular matrices of same size
      @ requires a != null;
      @ requires b != null;

      @ ensures (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < \result.length; \result[ii] != null && \result[ii].length == a[0].length);

      @ ensures \fresh(\result);
```
```
      @ ensures (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < \result.length; \fresh(\result[ii]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
```

```
          @   maintaining a.length == n && b.length == n;
          @   maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < n ==> a[p] != null && a[p].length == m && b[p] != null && b[p].length == m);
          @   maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < i && 0 <= q && q < m
          @                 ==> c[p][q] == a[p][q] + b[p][q]);
          @   decreases n - i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;

        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
```

```
          @*/
```
```
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```
        int n = nums.length;
```

```
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```
```
          @ // For all pairs with first index < i, none sum to target.
```
```
          @ maintaining (\forall int a,b; 0 <= a && a < b && b < n && a < i;
          @                (long)nums[a] + (long)nums[b] != (long)target);
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            /*@ 
              @ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= n;
              @ // For all pairs with first index < i, none sum to target.
              @ maintaining (\forall int a,b; 0 <= a && a < b && b < n && a < i;
              @                (long)nums[a] + (long)nums[b] != (long)target);
              @ // For all b in [i+1, j), nums[i] + nums[b] != target.
              @ maintaining (\forall int b; i+1 <= b && b < j;
              @                (long)nums[i] + (long)nums[b] != (long)target);
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @   ensures \result == null;

      @            && (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length);

      @               \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]);
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

          @   maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @   decreases m - i;

                return null;
```

```
          @   maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < m; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
          @   decreases m - i;
          @*/

              @   maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @   maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < j;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @   assigns \nothing;

      @     (

      @       (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
      @           ( (digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 0) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 1) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 8) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 9) ||
      @             (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - 1 - i] == 6)
      @           )
      @       )
      @       &&

          @                    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - 1 - j] == 6)
          @                  )
          @                );
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i,j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length;

    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
```

```
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
      @ //  - they form a pair that sums to target,

      @ //  - for that i, j is the smallest index > i that forms a solution.

      @ ensures (\forall int ii, jj; 0 <= ii && ii < jj && jj < nums.length ==> nums[ii] + nums[jj] != target)

      @ ensures (\exists int ii, jj; 0 <= ii && ii < jj && jj < nums.length && nums[ii] + nums[jj] == target)

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int a; 0 <= a && a < i; (\forall int b; a < b && b < n ==> nums[a] + nums[b] != target));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;

            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int b; i + 1 <= b && b < j ==> nums[i] + nums[b] != target);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {

    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
    /*@ 
      @ // Case: null or empty matrix -> false
      @ public normal_behavior
      @   requires a == null || a.length == 0;

      @   ensures \result == false;

      @ // Case: non-empty matrix -> true iff it is an n-by-n identity matrix

      @           && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
      @                   (i == j ==> a[i][j] == 1)

      @       )
      @   );
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < i;

            //@ maintaining (\forall int c; 0 <= c < j;

            //@                );

                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;

                }
            }
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
      @ // Behavior when any input is null or total length would overflow int
      @ also

      @   assigns \nothing;

      @
      @ // Behavior when both inputs are non-null and total length fits in int

      @   assigns \nothing;

      @   ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;

      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == \old(a[i])); // a unchanged
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; b[i] == \old(b[i])); // b unchanged
      @   ensures \result != a && \result != b;
```

```
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];
```
