      // (Writes only go to the newly allocated result, if any.)
      assigns \nothing;

      // The method returns null exactly when one input is null or the total
      // length would exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE (the exact condition tested in the code).
      ensures (a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
              <==> (\result == null);

      // When a non-null result is returned, it is a freshly allocated array whose
      // contents are exactly the concatenation of the *pre-state* contents of a and b
      // in that order. Also the inputs are preserved (not modified).
      ensures \result != null
              ==> (
                    \fresh(\result)
                 && \result.length == a.length + b.length
                 // first part copied from a (pre-state values)
                 && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == \old(a[i]))
                 // second part copied from b (pre-state values)
                 && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == \old(b[i]))
                 // inputs are not modified (if they exist)
                 && (a != null ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == \old(a[i])))
                 && (b != null ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; b[i] == \old(b[i])))
                 // result is newly allocated and does not alias the inputs
                 && \result != a && \result != b
                 );

      // Complete specification: the two cases above cover all behaviors of the method.
    @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == \old(a[j]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == \old(a[j]));
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j + m] == \old(b[j]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

      @ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length;
      @               adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int i,j;
      @                        0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length &&
      @                        0 <= j && j < adjacencyMat.length ==>
      @                        adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
      @*/
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        /* Outer loop invariant:
           - i is within bounds
           - for every processed row index p < i, the symmetry property holds
             for all q > p (i.e. all pairs with first index < i are symmetric).
        */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
        //@                 (\forall int q; p < q && q < nVert ==>
        //@                    adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases nVert - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {

            /* Inner loop invariant:
               - i is fixed and in range
               - j progresses from i+1 to nVert
               - symmetry already holds for all pairs with first index < i (carried from outer invariant)

            //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i < nVert;

            //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;

            //@                    adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));

public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())

        while (index < x.length) {

            return false;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {

                index = index + 1;

        }
        return true;

    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

      @   // Behaviour when input is null: returns null
      @   requires arr == null;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @ also
      @   // Behaviour when input is non-null: returns a fresh array with same length
      @   requires arr != null;
      @   assigns \nothing;

      @   ensures \result.length == arr.length;
      @   // For each position i, the output is computed exactly as in the implementation:
      @   // - whitespace characters are copied unchanged,
      @   // - the first character of the array and any character immediately following a whitespace
      @   //   are converted with Character.toTitleCase,
      @   // - other non-whitespace characters are converted with Character.toLowerCase.
      @   ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length ==>
      @         ( Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ? \result[i] == arr[i]
      @         : ( (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ? \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])
      @                                                           : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]) ) );
      @   behaviors disjoint, complete;

          @   maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
          @   loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;

public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

    //@  assigns \nothing;

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

      // Case: method returns null when either input is null or the lengths would overflow
      requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      assigns \nothing;
      ensures \result == null;
      also
      // Case: both arrays non-null and total length fits in an int
      requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      assigns \result, \result[*];
      ensures \result != null;
      ensures \fresh(\result);
      ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;

      behaviors disjoint;
      behaviors complete;
    @*/

            return null;

        int n = b.length;

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    /*@

      @ requires nums != null && nums.length <= 1;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == true;
      @ also

      @ requires nums != null && nums.length >= 2;

      @                      || (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length-1; nums[i] > nums[i+1]));
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        /*@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j+1]);
          @ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}

```
Rules (apply all, exactly as written):

public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long)x * (long)y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        /* Outer loop invariants:
           - i ranges between 0 and m
           - res equals i * n (as a long) at loop head
         */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining res == (long)i * n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /* Inner loop invariants:
               - j ranges between 0 and n
               - res equals i * n + j (as a long) at inner loop head
             */
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long)i * n + j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

    //@  requires txt != null;

    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

                (digits[j] == 8 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 8) ||
                (digits[j] == 6 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 9) ||
                (digits[j] == 9 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 6))
            )
            &&
            (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
             (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 ||
              digits[digits.length/2] == 1 ||
              digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
          );
        // If the method returns false then either some pair fails the relation
        // or (when length is odd) the middle digit is not one of {0,1,8}.
        ensures (!\result) ==>
          (
            (\exists int j; 0 <= j && j < digits.length/2;
               !(
                 (digits[j] == 0 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 0) ||
                 (digits[j] == 1 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 1) ||
                 (digits[j] == 8 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 8) ||
                 (digits[j] == 6 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 9) ||
                 (digits[j] == 9 && digits[digits.length - j - 1] == 6)
               )
            )
            ||
            (digits.length % 2 == 1 &&
             !(digits[digits.length/2] == 0 ||
               digits[digits.length/2] == 1 ||
               digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
          );
    @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        /*@
          maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
          maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
            ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
             (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
             (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
             (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
             (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
          loop_writes i;
          decreases (len/2) - i;
        @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;

}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

     * Precise, complete specification matching the implementation:
     * - a must be non-null (avoids NPE).
     * - method does not modify any memory (assigns \nothing).
     * - if a.length == 0 the method returns -1.
     * - otherwise the method returns the smallest index m (0 <= m < a.length)
     *   such that a[m] is a global maximum of the array (a[m] >= a[i] for all i).
     *   The last conjunct below states uniqueness: any index that satisfies the
     *   same "first global maximum" property must equal \result.
     */
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (a.length == 0 ==> \result == -1)
    //@      && (a.length > 0 ==>
    //@           (0 <= \result && \result < a.length
    //@            && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[\result] >= a[i])           // a[result] is a global maximum
    //@            && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < \result; a[j] < a[\result])           // \result is the first occurrence of that maximum
    //@            && (\forall int m; 0 <= m < a.length;
    //@                   ( (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[m] >= a[i])         // if m is a global maximum
    //@                     && (\forall int k; 0 <= k < m; a[k] < a[m])            // and no earlier index has that value
    //@                   ) ==> m == \result)                                      // then m must equal result (uniqueness)
    //@           )
    //@         );
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        /* Loop invariants:
         * - index ranges over [0..a.length]
         * - biggest is a valid index while array non-empty
         * - among seen indices 0..index-1, a[biggest] is the maximum value
         *   and biggest is the first index attaining that maximum (so earlier
         *   indices are strictly less).
         */
        //@ assert a.length > 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= index && index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest && biggest < a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < index; a[biggest] >= a[k];
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < biggest; a[j] < a[biggest];
        //@ loop_writes index, biggest;
        //@ decreases a.length - index;
        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }

     *   occurrence of a global maximum of the array: the returned index is
     *   within bounds, its element is >= every element of the array, and no

     *   attaining the maximum).

    //@            && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[\result] >= a[i])          // a[result] is a global maximum
    //@            && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < \result; a[j] < a[\result])          // first occurrence of that maximum
    //@           )
    //@         );
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {

            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

         * - index ranges over [0..a.length]

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

     *   such that a[m] is a global maximum of the array (a[m] >= a[i] for all i).

    //@                   ) ==> m == \result)                                      // then m must equal result (uniqueness)
    //@           )
    //@         );
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        /* Loop invariants:
         * - index ranges over [0..a.length]
         * - biggest is a valid index while array non-empty
         * - among seen indices 0..index-1, a[biggest] is the maximum value
         *   and biggest is the first index attaining that maximum (so earlier
         *   indices are strictly less).
         */

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index && index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest && biggest < a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < index; a[biggest] >= a[k];
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < biggest; a[j] < a[biggest];
        //@ loop_writes index, biggest;
        //@ decreases a.length - index;
        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@ requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length;
    //@               adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int p; 0 <= p < adjacencyMat.length;
    //@                         \forall int q; 0 <= q < adjacencyMat.length;
    //@                           (p < q ==> adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));

public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsReverseArray {
    //@  requires x != null;
    //@  requires y != null;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

```

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

      // The method does not modify any pre-existing memory visible to the caller.
      assigns \nothing;

      // If input is null, result is null.
      ensures (vec == null) ==> (\result == null);

      // If input is non-null, the method returns a fresh array of the same length,
      // does not alias the input array, does not modify the input array,
      // and each returned element is the saturated 32-bit product of vec[i] and a.
      ensures (vec != null) ==>
        ( \result != null
          && \fresh(\result)
          && \result.length == vec.length
          && \result != vec
          && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < vec.length ==>
                ( \old(vec[i]) == vec[i] ) // input array is not modified
             && ( ((long)\old(vec[i]) * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
                   ==> \result[i] == Integer.MAX_VALUE )
             && ( ((long)\old(vec[i]) * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
                   ==> \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE )
             && ( ((long)\old(vec[i]) * (long)a) >= Integer.MIN_VALUE
                   && ((long)\old(vec[i]) * (long)a) <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
                   ==> \result[i] == (int)((long)\old(vec[i]) * (long)a) )
           )
        );
    @*/
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        /*@
          maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
          maintaining ret != null && ret.length == vec.length;
          // For already-processed indices j < i, ret[j] already contains the
          // saturated product of the original vec[j] and a; the input vec is unchanged.
          maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i ==>
                        ( \old(vec[j]) == vec[j]
                          && (((long)\old(vec[j]) * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
                                 ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                          && (((long)\old(vec[j]) * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
                                 ==> ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
                          && (((long)\old(vec[j]) * (long)a) >= Integer.MIN_VALUE
                                 && ((long)\old(vec[j]) * (long)a) <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
                                 ==> ret[j] == (int)((long)\old(vec[j]) * (long)a))
                        )
                      );
          loop_writes ret[*], i;
          decreases vec.length - i;
        @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@ requires (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < nums.length;
    //@               Integer.MIN_VALUE/2 <= nums[p] && nums[p] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE/2);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result != nums;
    //@ // result is empty iff no pair (p,q) with 0 <= p < q < nums.length sums to target
    //@ ensures (\result.length == 0) <==>
    //@         (\forall int p,q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < nums.length; nums[p] + nums[q] != target);
    //@ // If a pair exists then result is [i0,j0] where (i0,j0) is the lexicographically first pair
    //@ // encountered by the nested loops: smallest i0 with some j0, and for that i0 the
    //@ // smallest j0 such that nums[i0]+nums[j0]==target.
    //@ ensures (\result.length == 2) <==>
    //@         (\exists int i0, j0;
    //@            0 <= i0 && i0 < j0 && j0 < nums.length
    //@         && nums[i0] + nums[j0] == target
    //@         && (\forall int p, q;
    //@               0 <= p && p < q && q < nums.length && nums[p] + nums[q] == target
    //@               ==> (p > i0) || (p == i0 && q >= j0))
    //@         && \result[0] == i0 && \result[1] == j0);
    //@ ensures (\result.length == 0) || (\result.length == 2);
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < n && p < i; nums[p] + nums[q] != target);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int q; i+1 <= q && q < j; nums[i] + nums[q] != target);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < n && p < i; nums[p] + nums[q] != target);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }

    }

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

            }

        }

        return true;
    }

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@ ensures a > b ==> \result == null;
    //@ ensures a <= b ==>
    //@   (\result != null
    //@    && \fresh(\result)
    //@    && \result.length == b - a + 1
    //@    && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < \result.length; \result[i] == a + i));
    public static int[] closedInterval(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return null;

        int n = b - a + 1;
        int[] arr = new int[n];

        /* Loop invariants describing the partial initialization:
           - i stays within [0,n]
           - for all j < i, arr[j] == a + j
         */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; arr[j] == a + j;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = a + i;
        }

        return arr;
    }
}

    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

      @ // The method reads the rectangle coordinates from the arrays as:
      @ // left1 = rec1[0], bottom1 = rec1[1], right1 = rec1[2], top1 = rec1[3]
      @ // left2 = rec2[0], bottom2 = rec2[1], right2 = rec2[2], top2 = rec2[3]
      @ //

      @ // (open intervals on boundaries induced by comparisons used in code)

      @ ensures \result == (
      @     (rec2[1] < rec1[3]) && // bottom2 < top1
      @     (rec2[3] > rec1[1]) && // top2 > bottom1

      @     (rec2[2] > rec1[0])    // right2 > left1

      @     rec2[1] >= rec1[3] ||  // bottom2 >= top1  -> rec2 is above or touching rec1 (no overlap)
      @     rec2[3] <= rec1[1] ||  // top2 <= bottom1  -> rec2 is below or touching rec1 (no overlap)
      @     rec2[0] >= rec1[2] ||  // left2 >= right1  -> rec2 is to the right or touching rec1 (no overlap)
      @     rec2[2] <= rec1[0]     // right2 <= left1  -> rec2 is to the left or touching rec1 (no overlap)
      @ );
      @ 
      @ pure
      @*/
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@  assigns \nothing;

            return false;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}

```

public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    /*
      Behaviors:
       - if arr == null or arr.length == 0 the method returns -1
       - otherwise it returns the smallest index i (0 <= i < arr.length-1)
         such that there exists j with i < j < arr.length and arr[i] == arr[j],
         or -1 if no such index exists.
    */

    //@  requires arr == null || arr.length == 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr != null && arr.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length-1;
    //@               (\exists int j; i < j && j < arr.length && arr[i] == arr[j]))
    //@           ==> (
    //@                 0 <= \result && \result < arr.length-1
    //@                 && (\exists int j; \result < j && j < arr.length && arr[\result] == arr[j])
    //@                 && (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < \result;
    //@                        (\forall int j; k < j && j < arr.length ==> arr[k] != arr[j]))
    //@               );
    //@  ensures !(\exists int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length-1;
    //@                (\exists int j; i < j && j < arr.length && arr[i] == arr[j]))
    //@           ==> \result == -1;
    //@  behaviors disjoint;
    //@  behaviors complete;
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length - 1;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i;
        //@            (\forall int j; k < j && j < arr.length ==> arr[k] != arr[j]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= arr.length;
            //@ maintaining \forall int k; i+1 <= k && k < j ==> arr[i] != arr[k];
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases arr.length - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {

                    return false;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;

    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {

                dec = false;

    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

      @  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < a.length; a[r] != null && a[r].length == a[0].length);

public class CopyArray {
    public static void CopyArray(int[] b, int iBegin, int iEnd, int[] a) {
        int k = iBegin;

        while (iEnd - k > 0) {
            a[k] = b[k];
            k = k + 1;
        }
    }
}

public class CopyArray {
    /*@ 
      @ requires b != null && a != null;
      @ requires 0 <= iBegin && iBegin <= iEnd && iEnd <= b.length && iEnd <= a.length;
      @ 
      @ // method only writes the specified slice of a
      @ assigns a[iBegin .. iEnd-1];
      @ 
      @ // after the call, elements in [iBegin,iEnd) of a equal the old values of b at those positions
      @ ensures (\forall int j; iBegin <= j && j < iEnd; a[j] == \old(b[j]));
      @ 
      @ // elements of a outside [iBegin,iEnd) are unchanged
      @ ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length && (j < iBegin || j >= iEnd) ==> a[j] == \old(a[j]));
      @ 
      @ // b is not modified
      @ ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < b.length ==> b[j] == \old(b[j]));
      @*/
    public static void CopyArray(int[] b, int iBegin, int iEnd, int[] a) {
        int k = iBegin;

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining iBegin <= k && k <= iEnd;
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; iBegin <= j && j < k; a[j] == \old(b[j]));
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length && (j < iBegin || j >= k) ==> a[j] == \old(a[j]));
          @ loop_writes a[iBegin .. iEnd-1], k;
          @ decreases iEnd - k;
          @*/
        while (iEnd - k > 0) {
            a[k] = b[k];
            k = k + 1;
        }
    }

     * Two behaviours:

     * - If arr != null, the method returns true iff all pairs of distinct indices
     *   contain different values; it does not modify state.

        if (arr == null) return true;

         * Invariant (informally): For every pair (p,q) with 0 <= p < q < arr.length,

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

    //@           : ( ((long)vec[k] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
    //@               ? Integer.MIN_VALUE
    //@               : (int)((long)vec[k] * (long)a)
    //@             )
    //@       )
    //@   );
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@     ret[j] == (
        //@       ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
        //@         ? Integer.MAX_VALUE
        //@         : ( ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
        //@             ? Integer.MIN_VALUE
        //@             : (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a)
        //@           )
        //@     )
        //@ );
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases vec.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

        return ret;
